current_deliverables: An integrated prototype now implements role-based browser workflows, twelve SQL tables, two reporting views, atomic checkout/restocking and MongoDB review/profile CRUD with validators, indexes and feedback pipelines. Both source datasets are cached with checksums. Full seeding loaded 200 orders, 100 purchase-linked reviews, 50 profiles and 1,000 external sentences; rerunning added no duplicates. Verification passed 44 unit checks, 16 real MariaDB/MongoDB integration checks and eight browser acceptance scenarios. The comparison returned identical answers at 1,000, 10,000 and 50,000 reviews over 30 repeated timings per size. Remaining work includes teammate installation checks, final report/reflections and the all-member presentation.
